- **Tournament spectator mode**: trusted casters can be granted access to see live hands during a tournament match, selected at tournament creation, with an optional "no hands" mode; casters can no longer also be players in the same tournament.
- **Same-turn infinite combo detection**: warns after 3 repeats of the same board state and auto-passes the turn on the 4th, with the warning also shown as a dialog popup (not just a status badge); a handful of Chaos Draft effects that could otherwise loop forever without ever repeating an exact board state are now detected too, offering a shortcut instead.
- **Fixed a still-waiting game (deck submission not yet done) crashing the board** with a missing `loop_warning` field.
- **Fixed Pride's granted extra play being lost across separate requests** when Betrayal (spent using that same grant) gave Pride itself to the same opponent the grant was tracking, momentarily tying mood counts mid-play.
